services.name: 4 Hour SHARE Kauai Sportfishing Tour
services.desc: Join us on a public fishing charter to share a fun experience with likeminded anglers in Kauai. All equipment is provided for your convenience. Important Information Our fishing vessel the "Pi'ikea' can take a maximum of 6 people. Our SHARE tour, we require a minimum of 4 people to confirm the tour. You are welcome to pay for the additional space to confirm a trip. Once on board we'll give a short safety briefing and get on our way. Time for the tour starts once we leave the dock. About Typically, we'll begin setting the lines in the water as we are exiting the outer break wall and officially Max 6 people • Min 4 People to confirm tour

blurb: Guests join deep sea fishing charters on a 45-foot fishing vessel named Piikea. They fish for species including Marlin, Ahi Tuna, Mahi Mahi, Ono, and Aku. Charters are available for beginners to experienced anglers with options for private or shared groups.
